This suggests the AI may have generated ambiguous fin structures that don't cleanly map to expected anatomy, or the pose model is struggling with the shark's unique morphology. The topology_boundary_auditor shows a clean mask (confidence 1.0003), suggesting the shark's boundary is well-defined. The geometric_depth_auditor shows reasonable depth statistics. The Router underestimated the structural uncertainty indicated by the pose auditor's low confidence keypoints. This isn't necessarily 'melting' but indicates anatomical ambiguity that's characteristic of AI generation struggling with non-standard subjects.
